full_ros_TudoRun02.live_output_boundary: 2355 backend inputs and saved dense samples; 2311 live outputs. Missing live stamps are retained as an unresolved publication/clock/scheduling boundary, not claimed as complete output coverage.

limitations: No universal 10 cm or half-core acceptance; native input frequencies differ (10/20/30 Hz).
Ground-truth gaps excluded and reported; no angular acceptance without independent frame calibration.
Hall clock correction is an observer-only prefix-fit diagnostic, not algorithm improvement.
Mapping baseline is not a real-data relocalization or map-extension qualification.
Final trajectories include subsequent loop corrections; live output remains the online accuracy measure.
Frontend and core CPU are separate; staged core includes backlog drain, excludes loading/saving and ROS. Full ROS resource includes startup/shutdown.
The installed n3m node is old ABI. First full_ros attempt exited before replay; full_ros_current uses matching build adapters without installation.
Initial unpaced/no-ACK M2DGR attempts were incomplete and excluded. Raw artifacts retained.
